notes.title: Strange Encounter is available!
notes.notes:
After several months of intensive work in my spare time, I am proud to announce that Strange Encounter, my first game developed with the Unreal Engine 4 has been released. I hope you will enjoy the little adventure. 

Feel free to give me feedback so that I can take it into account for a future game.

notes.title: Strange Encounter is released on November 9th on steam
notes.notes:
After several months of hard work in my spare time, I am proud to announce that my first game "Strange Encounter" developed with the unreal engine 4 will be available for free on steam on November 9, 2018!

I really hope you can give me a constructive feedback on my game to know what you liked and didn't like. In order to be able to progress. 

The game should also soon be translated into Spanish and German.
